versions.content: ApplicationEndpoint priority The priority at the Ap- plicationEndpoint shall be used as Ethernet Header information together with the vlanIdentifier . If defined the priority overwrites the defaultPriority that is defined in the VlanMembership and the priority that is defined at the Net- workEndpoint .
